result.title: Multimodal Information Interactions Bottleneck for Multimodal Self-Supervised Learning
result.comment: 15 pages, 3-page supplementary material provided as an ancillary file. Accepted for publication in IEEE Transactions on Pattern Analysis and Machine Intelligence (TPAMI)
result.summary: Multimodal self-supervised learning is challenged by heterogeneity, unequal informativeness, and complex information interactions across multimodal data sources such as images, text, audio, and tabular data. While contrastive methods effectively align shared semantics, they typically rely on strong multi-view redundancy assumptions, overlooking modality-specific and synergistic information, thus leading to suboptimal representations. We propose the Multimodal Information Interactions Bottleneck (MIIB), a principled framework grounded in Partial Information Decomposition that explicitly encodes redundant, unique, and synergistic information within multimodal interactions. MIIB employs a dual-path model architecture for modality-specific encoding and multimodal fusion, optimized using surrogate tractable entropy-based objectives that enforce minimal sufficient representations without requiring explicit mutual information estimation. By leveraging variational bounds and score-based entropy estimation, MIIB efficiently captures complex cross-modal interactions while suppressing superfluous information. Experiments across diverse benchmarks demonstrate consistent improvements over state-of-the-art multimodal self-supervised methods. Code is available at https://github.com/wanglingzaishi/MIIB.

AI.brief_summary: 该文提出 MIIB 框架，借助部分信息分解显式区分多模态交互中的冗余、独有与协同信息，用双路径编码加融合结构并以变分界和基于 score 的熵估计构造可处理目标，学习最小充分表示。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「抑制冗余、保留独有与协同信息」的表示约束与 LVR 中视觉细节保留、信息坍缩问题相通，可供核查能否用作 latent 推理状态的训练监督目标；但论文面向多模态自监督表示学习，未涉及推理期状态生成。
